lines.en: I call Io and the two of us make plans to meet at the dorms and then...immediately leave that location because, as Io puts it, “there is far too much estrogen there.”
lines.zh: 我给 Io 打了电话，我们约在宿舍见面，然后……立刻离开那个地方，因为用 Io 的话说，「那里的雌激素太多了」。

lines.en: And while I admire her ability to feel hormones in the air, I don’t think I admire it enough to understand why we can’t just talk there instead.
lines.zh: 虽然我挺佩服她能从空气里「感觉」到荷尔蒙，但我还没佩服到能理解为什么我们不能就在那儿聊。

lines.en: Either way, I play along and follow her to the nearby strip of small shops and restaurants I’ve visited with Ami and some of the others before.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我配合着跟她去了附近那一排小店铺和餐馆——我以前和 Ami 她们来过。

lines.en: Io takes a seat on the ground in the middle of what is currently an empty lot-slash-indie venue type thing despite there being benches literally all around us and I am forced to sit on the floor as well.
lines.zh: 尽管我们四周到处都是长椅，Io 还是在一块空地兼独立演出场地似的地方中央席地而坐，我也只好跟着坐在地上。

lines.en: She says a bunch of stuff about how happy she is that I would “waste my time on someone like her,” and, like always, I’m not really sure what I’m supposed to do about that.
lines.zh: 她说了一大堆，说她很高兴我愿意「把时间浪费在她这样的人身上」；和往常一样，我实在不知道该怎么回应。

lines.en: Io feels like the one person I’ve met so far who just...hasn’t really changed at all.
lines.zh: Io 感觉像是我到目前为止遇到的人里，唯一一个……压根儿没怎么变过的。

lines.en: And I’m not sure if she’s just too far gone to be reached at this point, but I know that it’ll be dangerous for her and the few people she loves if she keeps it up.
lines.zh: 我不确定她是不是已经走得太远、够不着了，但我知道，她要是再这么下去，对她和她爱的那几个人都会很危险。

lines.en: Once the town wakes up and more people start passing by, the two of us pick ourselves off the ground and start heading back to the estrogen minefield known as “the dorms.”
lines.zh: 等镇子醒过来、路人多了起来，我们俩从地上爬起来，往那个被称为「宿舍」的雌激素雷区走回去。

lines.en: Io isn’t happy about this, of course, and talks about how she wishes she could spend the entire day with me instead.
lines.zh: Io 当然不乐意，一个劲说她多希望能和我待上一整天。

lines.en: For a moment, I think about inviting her to do just that.
lines.zh: 有那么一瞬间，我想干脆就邀请她这么做。

lines.en: But as I open my mouth, another self-loathing comment spills out of hers and makes me question my decision.
lines.zh: 可我刚要开口，她又冒出一句自我厌恶的话，让我对自己的决定产生了怀疑。

lines.en: In the end, she heads back inside to be miserable without me and I head off in the opposite direction to be complacent without her.
lines.zh: 最后，她回屋里去，在没有我的情况下继续难受；我朝相反方向走开，在没有她的情况下继续得过且过。
Io 的好感度提升到了 [io_love]!
